acceptance_gate.criterion: at least 75% of cards have governance median >= 4
acceptance_gate.purpose: engineering gate preventing a few high-scoring cards from masking failure on most cards

claim_limit: does not establish actual utility, workflow efficiency, decision effect, governance effect, expert-consensus reliability, threshold correctness, or SLO approval

items.evidence_flag_correctness: whether insufficient-evidence or anomaly flags are accurate
items.governance_appropriateness: whether confirmation, refusal, or contextual review is appropriate
items.overall_revision_value: original wording asks whether governance information has actual increment over threshold-only output; manuscript reports this as evaluator-perceived incremental information
items.runtime_actionability: whether the added governance state supports runtime disposition
items.threshold_plausibility: whether the raw threshold can serve as a candidate starting point

name: expert content-appropriateness evaluation of governance disposition
